message: border-radius isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android (10 places)
hint: Round corners can be used in VML with the `RoundRect` element. See the [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/msdn-online-vml-roundrect-element).

message: letter-spacing is only partly supported in Outlook Windows (4 places)
hint: Partial. Big negative values are rendered differently from CSS standards.

message: linear-gradient() isn't supported in Outlook Windows, Outlook.com, Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android; partly in Gmail Android (2 places)
hint: Gradients can be created in VML using `type="gradient"` on a `<v:fill>`. See [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/web-workshop---how-to-use-vml-on-web-pages-----fill--element#gradient-fill).

message: an rgba() colour isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Gmail Desktop Webmail, Gmail iOS, Gmail Android, Gmail Mobile Webmail, Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android

message: background-image isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android

message: opacity isn't supported in Gmail Mobile Webmail, Outlook Windows
hint: Those clients ignore it; drop the property or narrow --targets.

message: Outlook button size is estimated; give the button a px width

message: <a href> around a block: the link moves onto the 5 text runs or images inside
hint: Email clients can't make a whole box a link (Outlook drops a link around a table), so each text run and image inside gets the href; the padding between them isn't clickable.
